cms_provider_record.interpretation: The exact-CCN CMS record binds CCN, hospital name, Tulsa address/state and Tribal ownership. Ownership alone is not treated as the scope basis.

tribal_operator_and_facility.operator: Muscogee Nation Department of Health (MCN Health)
tribal_operator_and_facility.operator_observation: The Nation's current hospital list says MCN Health operates three community hospitals and lists Council Oak Comprehensive Healthcare among them; it notes the hospitals serve tribal citizens and the general public and accept Medicare, Medicaid and private insurance.
tribal_operator_and_facility.facility_page_observation: The current first-party Council Oak page names the facility, describes inpatient and outpatient hospital services, and gives 10109 E 79th St, Tulsa, OK 74133, matching the exact CMS record and roster. In-app browser rendering exposed a Price Transparency link, but this review did not retrieve or assign a CMS-format MRF.
tribal_operator_and_facility.official_about_observation: The Nation's Department of Health says the Muscogee Nation entered an Indian Self-Determination compact with IHS in 2002 to provide healthcare for its people; it says the health system is under the Nation's Executive Branch.
tribal_operator_and_facility.ihs_current_participation_observation: IHS's current Self-Governance Tribes list identifies Muscogee (Creek) Nation as an Oklahoma City Area participant, fiscal year 2003. IHS defines Title V self-governance as tribal assumption of IHS program funds and control/accountability for health programs the Tribe chooses to assume.
tribal_operator_and_facility.ihs_program_explanation_observation: IHS describes Title V self-governance compacts as a way for Tribes to assume control over IHS health care programs.
tribal_operator_and_facility.current_program_funding_observation: HHS TAGGS recipient data lists FY2026 IHS SELF-GOVERNANCE awards to MUSCOGEE (CREEK) NATION, including action dates through July 21, 2026. This is program-level recipient evidence and does not allocate a particular award to Council Oak.

legal_basis.regulation_observation: CMS deems hospitals operated by an Indian Health Program, as defined in section 4(12) of the Indian Health Care Improvement Act, to be in compliance with Part 180.
legal_basis.statute_observation: An Indian Health Program includes a tribal health program. A tribal health program is a Tribe or tribal organization that operates a health program, service, activity or facility funded in whole or part by IHS through an ISDEAA contract or compact.
legal_basis.basis_application: CMS ties exact CCN 370244 to Council Oak at the exact Tulsa campus and records Tribal ownership. The Nation's current operator/facility pages identify MCN Health as the operator of Council Oak; the Nation and IHS document MCN's current self-governance compact/program, and HHS TAGGS shows current IHS Self-Governance awards to the Nation. Together these identify Council Oak as operated by MCN Health within the Nation's IHS self-governance health system; no facility-specific TAGGS allocation is claimed.

prior_pricing_pointer_evidence.interpretation: Retain the existing exact-pointer finding that its machine-readable CSV identifies the separate Okmulgee campus, not Council Oak. The May 2026 first-party XLSX remains only a format/file lead and is not promoted to a current CSV/JSON MRF. This scope classification neither erases that provenance nor asserts MRF availability, absence, linkage or quality.

disposition_change_reason: New exact-CCN CMS ownership/address evidence plus current first-party evidence identifying Council Oak as operated by MCN Health, independently corroborated by current IHS self-governance participation and current HHS IHS Self-Governance awards, supports the specific 45 CFR 180.30(b)(2) Indian Health Program scope category. The basis is documented program operation, not tribal name or ownership alone.
interpretation: This is a scope classification, not a pricing-data recovery or MRF quality/compliance claim. Preserve the prior sibling-file exclusion and XLSX lead as historical source evidence. No file was imported or assigned. The 891-cohort unresolved count effect is -1.
